accuracy_note: Coarse presence-detection accuracy (does the finding_type's coarse category — vehicle/personnel/none — match ground truth), not a closed-set classification accuracy. See docs/limitations.md: in this sample the model defaults to vehicle_presence for nearly every image, and nearly every VisDrone image contains a vehicle, so this number is inflated by class imbalance, not a sign of strong discrimination — reported honestly, not celebrated.
